## Plugin to take over
- **Plugin name:**
- **Plugin ID:**
- **Path in repository:**
- **Current author / maintainer (GitHub handle):** @

## What do you want to take over?
- [ ] The plugin name
- [ ] The plugin ID
- [ ] The existing codebase (continue development of this plugin)

## Eligibility requirements
<!-- Both conditions must be met before a takeover can be approved. -->

- [ ] The plugin has been **unmaintained for at least 1 month**
  - **Last commit touching this plugin:** <!-- link and date -->
  - **Unanswered issues or pull requests:** <!-- links, if any -->
- [ ] The original author has been tagged on GitHub in this issue and has **not objected within 14 days**
  - **Date author was tagged:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
  - **Earliest date the request can proceed:** <!-- tagged date + 14 days -->

> Maintainers will tag the current author in this issue if you have not already done so. The 14-day period starts from that tag.

## Your plan
<!-- Briefly describe what you intend to do with the plugin. -->

- **Goals and planned changes:**
- **Will the plugin's purpose stay the same?** <!-- yes / no, and explain if it will change -->
- **Compatibility with current Zoraxy versions:**
- **Maintenance commitment:** <!-- how you plan to keep it updated -->

## About you
- **GitHub handle:** @
- **Relevant experience (other plugins, projects, contributions):**
- **Preferred contact method (besides GitHub):**

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues and did not find another takeover request for this plugin
- [ ] I have attempted to reach the original author (link to issue, comment, or email date): 
- [ ] I agree to follow the repository's plugin guidelines and license requirements
- [ ] I understand that approval is at the discretion of the repository maintainers
